# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you have found a security issue in SundialServer or its server mods, please **do not** open a public GitHub issue.

Open a private security advisory at https://github.com/HumanGenome/SundialServer/security/advisories/new. That is the only reporting channel. There is no security email address for this project; do not send reports to any address that claims to be one.

The Sundial app is retired. Its last release, 0.1.72, puts Solarpunk's own settings back; there will be no further releases. Its old releases stay on this repo for reference, and players do not need it on Solarpunk 1.3.0.

## Out of scope

- Vulnerabilities in retail Solarpunk. Report those to the game's publisher.
- Cheating and anti-cheat concerns. Sundial does not provide anti-cheat.
